Tether Firehose 3

A production stream of AI-written X3D scenes, each carrying its own hash-chained provenance record. Every hash, chain check, seal and verdict below is computed live in this page. Synthetic mode simulates the stream; Replay 11 Oct streams 174 real scenes from three small open models; Live run 17 Oct replays real calls to five current models, recorded as they happened, each scene validated on the fork, repaired from the validator's own report and rendered in X_ITE.

versions: v1 synthetic only · v2 replay of 174 real runs · v3 current (adds the recorded live run: real calls, span waterfall, repair diff)

Under the hood

the whole algorithm, with the selected scene's actual values

One meta line per step, about 600 bytes. A step is a span: prev is the parent span id and the hash of the first step is the trace id, so the same record exports as OpenTelemetry, PROV or OpenLineage and stays with the file after any trace store has expired it.
